title: Security Ops: Vulnerability & Secrets Roundup - 2025-11-07
content:
Attendees: Aisha Carter (chair), Mateo Alvarez, Rina Shah, Owen Park, Claire Nguyen, + notes from SRE rotation

Agenda:
- Quick status on active vulnerabilities identified in last 2 weeks
- Secrets incidents and detection coverage gaps
- Threat-modeling workshop prep (app infra + private deployments)
- Action item review and blockers

1) Vulnerability triage summary (top-of-meeting)
- Triage window: 2025-10-25 -> 2025-11-06
- New items triaged: 9 (4 high, 3 medium, 2 low)
  - SEC-4312 (high) - OpenSSL CVE: disclosed 2025-10-29, affects host agent in older dedicated nodes. Impact: potential MITM for control-plane telemetry if exploited. Current state: patch available upstream; patch rollout staged to dedicated pools. Owner: Mateo. Target: 2025-11-12 for full patch. Mitigation: network egress lock for control-plane, firewall rule enforced for legacy nodes.
  - SEC-4330 (high) - Dependency: token-middleware crate with deserialization bug -> Jwt forgery risk in a narrow codepath (internal RPC). Repro steps in Jira. Owner: Rina. Plan: patch in 2.1.3, feature flag off for earlier runtime. Target: 2025-11-10.
  - SEC-4351 (medium) - Embedding cache: incorrect TTL handling causes stale cache entries; could surface stale results but low confidentiality risk. Owner: Owen. Hotfix pushed to qa; monitoring alert added.
  - SEC-4360 (medium) - Console XSS found in release candidate 0.13. Review pending (Claire).

Notes:
- We prioritized by exploitability and customer-facing impact. Any high with public exploit gets immediate escalated pager. For the OpenSSL patch, Dedicated customers with pinned private clusters will be contacted by Solutions Eng.
- Action: Mateo to publish short customer advisory template by 2025-11-08.

2) Secrets posture and recent findings
- Incident recap: 2025-10-30 - auto-scan flagged a rotated AWS key embedded in a legacy YAML file in infra repo. Key had no active privileges but was present in historical commit. Discovery: secret-scan action flagged it during scheduled cron. Remediation: key rotated, repo scrubbed with BFG, PR to rotate any linked tokens. Postmortem draft: link in linked_artifacts.
- Current coverage gaps:
  - CI matrix: some experimental repos still lack pre-merge secret-scan. Action: Claire to onboard 6 repos from eng/temp by 2025-11-21.
  - Binary artifacts: scanner misses secrets in compressed .tar.gz artefacts in releases. Short-term: add a step to decompress and scan build artifacts in release pipeline. Owner: Owen.
  - Vault usage: ~72% of services use KMS+Vault for signing/secret storage. Target 90% by EOY 2025.

Secrets roadmap items (short bullets):
- Expand pre-commit hooks with fuzzy detection -> reduce noise and catch high-entropy strings earlier. (owner: Claire)
- Enforce commit-time reject for high-confidence secrets on mainline with opt-out CI token for infra-automation. (owner: Mateo)
- Proof-of-concept for ephemeral short-lived service accounts in Dedicated control plane; evaluate tradeoffs w/ customer-managed KMS. (owner: Rina)

3) Threat modeling: upcoming workshop prep
- Scope: private deployments (VPC + on-prem), hosted API control plane, and Dedicated edge nodes.
- Goals for workshop (2025-11-17):
  - Map trust boundaries for model artifacts, KV caches, telemetry, and control-plane RPCs
  - Identify high-value assets and likely attacker personas (insider, supply-chain, cloud tenant escape)
  - Produce prioritized mitigations: e.g., signing model artifacts, mutual TLS for control-plane RPCs, stricter image provenance checks
- Pre-reads distributed: draft threat-model canvas (linked in Confluence), list of known incidents and attack trees. Please review before 2025-11-14.
- Facilitators: Rina (threat modeling lead), Owen (SRE perspective), Aisha (security ops).

4) Open questions / decisions needed
- Rolling strategy for Dedicated pools with pinned models: can we automate a graceful node drain and model re-pinning? Engineering feasibility input requested from Serving Runtime team by 2025-11-11. (tag: BLOCKER for OpenSSL rollout)
- Do we accept short-term increased latency for control-plane telemetry to apply egress lock? Product needs sign-off for potential metrics drop. Product owner: Claire to coordinate.

5) Action items and owners (explicit)
- Mateo: Publish customer advisory template + coordinate Dedicated patch rollout schedule (due 2025-11-08).
- Rina: Patch token-middleware crate, open PR, and prepare rollback plan for 2.1.3 (due 2025-11-10).
- Owen: Add artifact-decompression secret-scan step; verify on staging releases (due 2025-11-14).
- Claire: Onboard pre-merge scanning to 6 repos and draft product impact memo re: telemetry egress lock (due 2025-11-21).
- All: Review threat-model canvas and add notes to Confluence (due 2025-11-14).

6) Quick standups / sync cadence notes
- We will keep weekly vulnerability standup at Fridays 09:30 PT. If a high-severity public exploit is disclosed, we switch to daily triage until resolved.
- Channel: #sec-ops-incident for real-time triage; use /pager on Slack for pages.

7) Misc notes & low-effort wins
- Add a CI badge for "last secret scan" to repo READMEs to increase visibility. (small task: Claire)
- Consider enabling binary scanning flagged rule only for releases to reduce noise in experimental workspaces.

8) Parking lot (not for this meeting)
- Research: hardware-backed attestation for on-prem inference nodes (further RnD).
- Longer-term: automatic model-signing pipeline integrated into model registry and rollout system.

Meeting adjourned 10:15 PT. Next meeting: 2025-11-14 09:30 PT.

Decision log summary (short):
- Prioritize OpenSSL node patch rollout across Dedicated (accepted)
- Add artifact decompression step to release pipelines (accepted)
- Threat-modeling workshop scheduled and pre-reads assigned (accepted)

Unresolved: plan for automated graceful drain for pinned Dedicated nodes (await Serving Runtime input).

Notes to self: follow up with Mateo on advisory template before EOD Monday; ping Serving Runtime eng lead for feasibility on drain automation.
